item: Stoplist batch 4 (R131, language group 3): 290 function, number, calendar and chrome words in sr bg el
summary: Third T5 batch under the maintainer's go (R131): sr 134, bg 49, el 107 words from the triage's accepted candidates (221 function words, 32 number words, 29 calendar words, 8 site chrome) against the same merged log as groups 1 and 2 (sha256 6467504ab8ab). Reading each word's other languages left out thirteen Serbian words with a content sense elsewhere (kod, dok, ono, ove, toga, smo, niko, niti, iza, bile, tome, neka, ovi), three Bulgarian ones (шест, ото, макар) and two English words in the Greek log; the tool itself refused joj, kome, kom, sva, неговата and против. The 290 words are declared in test_analytics_extract with the curly spelling of the four Greek elided forms. Hidden at query time, no re-index. Left: the Asian group, the single-reader languages and the layout PR.
